title: Space Crew Visual Novel - Early Access
author: waaachow
selftext:
Here’s my latest project!  
I’ve been evolving my visual novel engine from game to game, mostly using it for story segments, but this time I decided to double down and build a full visual novel around it.  
Most of it was built using Claude with MCP integrations for OpenArt and ElevenLabs. (I should probably drop one of those subscriptions at some point since there’s a bit of crossover now, although they were much more distinct when I originally signed up.)  
I’m really happy with how it’s turned out. One thing I especially wanted to achieve was making the backgrounds feel “alive” rather than just using static images, and I think that adds a lot to the atmosphere.
